notes_for_editor: Evidence is one OpenStreetMap node (name, observation tag, 421 m elevation) plus the Wikipedia page for the place. No source describes a tower's build date, staffing, status or site today. The map point is about 21.4 km (13.3 miles) southeast of the Ezel community's listed centre (great-circle distance from the two coordinate pairs, bearing about 140 degrees), so the name may refer to a feature away from the village, or the node may be misplaced; not resolved. The county field in the record is null and is left that way. The story is about 77 words, below the 120-word floor, because the sources support little more. Recommend holding it until a Kentucky source names this tower.
